about_the_game:
Blaze of Storm is a standard vertical scrolling shmup. The main character, a pilot, fights against enemies in cyberspace as a cyber diver.

Two types of weapons are available: a main weapon and a subweapon. The main weapon is a Vulcan shot that is fired in front of the player's ship. The subweapon type can be changed by getting an item.

Subweapons have different performance depending on their type. Some circle around the ship to defend against enemy bullets, others automatically track and attack the enemy, and so on.

In addition, subweapons can generate an explosion by hitting the enemy with the weapon itself, and this explosion can cause great damage to the enemy.

Enemies appear in cyberspace in a wide variety of shapes, including mecha, creatures, and plants.

This is a shmup in which you can take advantage of the properties of subweapons and their explosions to your advantage. Stay tuned!

In the demo version, only Caravan mode (5-minute score attack) is playable. Only local rankings are supported. Only the original version of music is included.

In the full version, Arcade mode (consisting of 7 areas and 3 difficulty levels) is playable.

Rankings support both local and online rankings.

Music includes the original version and chiptune arrangement version.
